title: EmojiCraft
description: This mod adds emojis from Discord
body:
![Thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ee6ed607e5379f567dc774ce3b04675dba0ef2a6.png)This Mod adds Discord emojis to minecraft!

You use them exactly the same like on discord!

How to use :emojiname:

This mod have over 4000+ emojis! (Including 7 custom pride emojis!)

WARNING YOU CAN ONLY FIND THIS MOD ON MODRINTH OR CURSEFORGE!

Curseforge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/emojicraft-fabric
